question: Will Pakistan’s weekly price index for essentials (SPI) rise in the week ending Thu 12 Nov 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The Pakistan Bureau of Statistics’ Sensitive Price Indicator (SPI) release for the week ended 2026-11-12 reports that the combined SPI increased compared with the previous week.
- "No": That release reports the SPI decreased or was unchanged.

Clarifications:
- Use the headline week-on-week change for the combined SPI as stated in the release text, not a single item or income group.
- PBS publishes the weekly SPI for the week ended Thursday on Friday; this release is expected between 2026-11-13T05:00:00Z and 2026-11-13T11:00:00Z.
